inspiration: a table-driven base64 decoder printed (int) on every lookup arm of its conditionals; the census of arm casts in docs/features/castternary/analysis.md

witness.repro: gcc -O0 b64.c (quantum, see the PR body); kuna decompile-all b64 --functions quantum
after: v4 = (a1[3] != '=') ? (unsigned int)*(char *)(a0 + (unsigned long)(unsigned char)a1[3]) : 0;  (a sign change: kept)

ida.cleanflight O0 0x803533c: if ( sub_8015ED4() ) v2 = (short)sub_8015EE4(); else v2 = -1;  kuna: (int)(short)sub_8015ee4() : -1 -> (short)sub_8015ee4() : -1
ida.diffutils diff O0 0xe2f8: if ( v17 ) v1 = tolower(v14); else v1 = v14;  kuna: ... : (unsigned long)v1 -> ... : v1

castbench.set: full: 45 binaries (coreutils fmt ls sort du cp tail wc, grep, gzip, diffutils cmp diff diff3 sdiff, tar, find) x O0/O2/O2-noinline; functions kuna and IDA both emit
castbench.base: origin/main c960fb18d (castbench arm main-c960fb18d); castternary off on the branch build is byte-identical to it on all 45 binaries
castbench.arm_cast_census: 176 whole-arm casts on main: 64 pointer, 76 float-to-unsigned-long idiom, 36 integer (3 dropped; the rest a pointer destination 10, a comparison source 8, a sign change 5, a narrowing 4, a conditional of another type 1, an untyped expression 2, a pointer arm 1, and the sign-changing twin arms of the dropped diff pair 2)

typesweep.arms: the same build, --option castternary off vs the default
typesweep.variables_rows_identical: every function's tp/fp/fn/gt_vars/decomp_vars row is identical in both arms

corpus.classification: every changed line is a conditional `dest = c ? a : b;` whose only difference is one arm's integer widening cast left out (with its parentheses where the cast wrapped a parenthesized operand); line counts per function are unchanged and no other line moves

speed.method: interleaved min-of-15 kuna decompile-all --json, castternary off vs the default (docs/features/castternary/speed.py)
